caseName: Arctic Slope Regional Corp. v. Nextwave Personal Communications Inc.
caseNameFull: ARCTIC SLOPE REGIONAL CORPORATION v. NEXTWAVE PERSONAL COMMUNICATIONS INC.

opinions.text: Motion of Urban Comm-North Carolina, Inc., for leave to file a brief as amici curiae in No. 01-653, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia granted. Case consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
